text: His companions shape his deen. Ask him gently: "Who are your friends? What brings you together?" — guidance through dialogue, not command.

review_defects.why: The Arabic word is 'lutf' (لطف), not 'rifq' (رفق). The translation uses the wrong Islamic term.
The Arabic 'صحبته' means 'his companionship' (abstract noun), not 'his companions' (concrete plural). The English shifts from the act to the people, slightly altering the nuance.
